question: Does Mei Wending's own attributed bibliographic statement in Wu'an lisuan shuji explain the later Ruan Yuan Chourenzhuan warning about li-cheng copying errors, and does it itself resolve original tabular or precision readings?

received_text.author_attribution: 清 梅文鼎撰; 四庫全書本 heading
received_text.online_provider: 中文維基文庫／四庫全書本錄文
received_text.exact_received_locus:
一大統歴立成註二卷
有布立成之法有攷立成之法不得其説則有以傳寫魯魚而施之步算者矣〈鼎〉故於歴家用數必慎思之思之不得不敢妄用也
received_text.contextual_authorial_report: Same received page's 郭太史歴草補註 entry states「深諳者希傳寫多誤」; the 明史歴志擬稿 entry reports「然寫本多誤皆手自步算」. These are other scoped authorial textual reports, not identified modern target table-glyph defects.

institutional_bibliographic_locator.author: 梅文鼎

institutional_bibliographic_locator.caveat: A catalogued Qing Qianlong Siku manuscript object is not evidence that the Wikisource transcription came from this specific NPM copy or that a new independent historical print/plate vote exists.

philology_and_13XE_reconciliation.bu_licheng: 布立成: construction or laying-out procedure for tabular li-cheng values; NOT automatically an exact recovered 疾捷法 coefficient generator
philology_and_13XE_reconciliation.kao_licheng: 攷立成: methods to check or audit such tables; distinct from any arbitrary calculation using an extant table
philology_and_13XE_reconciliation.conditional_syntax: 不得其説則有以傳寫魯魚而施之步算者矣: conditional risk if method is not understood, not a declarative identification of a particular original G893 or Xu-An entry as erroneous
philology_and_13XE_reconciliation.self_attribution: 〈鼎〉故 ... 不敢妄用: explicitly first-person as preserved in this later received Siku text; stronger for attribution of the general caution than 13XE third-person biography, but not an independently authenticated autograph
philology_and_13XE_reconciliation.relation_to_13XE: Ruan Yuan-attributed 《疇人傳》卷37 condensed the theme as「立成傳寫魯魚，不得其説，不敢妄用，作大統立成注二卷」. Similar wording and subject support an identifiable received-text parallel; direct copying direction or an independent first-person original is not established by this comparison.
philology_and_13XE_reconciliation.other_xing_circulation_locus: Same received Wu'an text under 一荅李祠部問歴一卷 reports 李古愚 made a hand-copy of 邢觀察《律歴攷》 from Mei's travelling books. Text-based reported circulation only: no identification of its juan45 leaf, date, recension, table correction or a proved ancestor/descendant print relation.
philology_and_13XE_reconciliation.numerical_scope: Neither passage supplies an original j45 table-B L132 last character (二/三), the source-native 疾-specific 捷法 constructor, 少/微 radix/carry, or an independently dated G893 numerical original. No candidate must be promoted by semantic analogy.

dates_and_independence.edition_or_copy_date: NPM catalog calls its physical copy 清乾隆間寫文淵閣四庫全書本; not verified as Wikisource's exact copy

edges_rejected_or_unproved: A later received Siku self-attributed account and a later biography with similar wording do not prove their exact copying relation or independent contemporary historical impressions.
A bibliography report that Mei possessed and circulated Xing's book does not bind the extant NLC Xu-An j45 L132 printing block, its last digit, or a correct historical coefficient construction.
unresolved_lineage_questions: Can a native folio or early independent original of Mei's 《大統歷立成註》 or 《勿菴歴算書記》 confirm the exact wording and source-specific worked calculations?
Can authenticated independent Xu-An j45 B L132 original strokes and source-native 疾捷法/少微 operations be retrieved?

next_action: Continue TW-OPEN-0005 P0 on independently source-bound original Xu-An j45 table-B L132 二/三 and source-native 疾捷法, 少/微 radix and carry; obtain an authorized free original Mei note/work page only if it adds independent mechanical evidence. Do not convert conditional self-account into a G893 numeric award or multiply same-scope Siku texts into independent votes.
